GHLS supplies clinics with FDA-compliant rapid diagnostics across four core categories — at pricing that protects your margins without compromising on quality or compliance.

Drug Testing COVID Testing Flu Testing Strep Testing

Drug Testing

Point-of-care drug testing panels.

Urine drug screening for workplace compliance, probation programs, pain management, and clinical monitoring. GHLS offers single-panel and multi-panel cup formats in high-volume quantities at wholesale pricing.

Quote Drug Testing Products

Multi-Panel Drug Test Cups

All-in-one specimen collection and testing. CLIA-waived. Available in 5, 10, 12, and 14-panel configurations with built-in adulterant checks.

  • 5-panel through 14-panel
  • Built-in validity/adulterant strips
  • CLIA-waived formats
  • Bulk packaging available

Single-Panel Dip Cards & Strips

Individual substance testing strips and cassette cards — ideal for targeted screening programs or cost-controlled panel selection.

  • THC, Opiates, Cocaine, Meth, Benzo
  • Fentanyl and synthetic opioids
  • Cassette and strip formats

Oral Fluid (Saliva) Tests

Non-invasive oral fluid drug screening for situations where urine collection is impractical. Rapid results with easy collection protocol.

  • 6-panel and 10-panel oral fluid
  • Rapid result (<10 min)
  • No observed collection required

COVID Testing

COVID-19 rapid antigen tests.

FDA-authorized rapid antigen tests for SARS-CoV-2 detection — suitable for symptomatic and screening use in clinic settings. CLIA-waived and professional-use formats available.

Quote COVID Testing Products

Rapid Antigen Tests (Professional Use)

FDA-authorized professional-use COVID-19 antigen tests for point-of-care settings. CLIA-waived. Results in 10–15 minutes.

  • Nasal swab antigen format
  • FDA-authorized, CLIA-waived
  • Results in 10–15 min
  • Bulk clinic packaging

Combo Flu A/B + COVID Tests

Single-test combo panels that simultaneously detect COVID-19 and Influenza A/B — ideal for respiratory illness season. Reduces per-patient testing cost significantly.

  • Flu A/B + COVID-19 combo
  • Single nasal swab collection
  • CLIA-waived

Flu Testing

Influenza A & B rapid diagnostics.

Point-of-care influenza testing for fast differentiation of Flu A vs. Flu B. High-sensitivity formats available for clinical environments that require confident negative results.

Quote Flu Testing Products

Rapid Influenza A & B Tests

Standard rapid influenza diagnostic tests (RIDTs) for point-of-care Flu A and Flu B detection. CLIA-waived. Results in under 15 minutes.

  • Differentiates Flu A vs. Flu B
  • Nasal or nasopharyngeal swab
  • CLIA-waived
  • Results in <15 min

High-Sensitivity Flu Tests

Higher-sensitivity influenza diagnostics for clinical settings where confident negative results are critical to patient management decisions.

  • Enhanced sensitivity format
  • Flu A + B differentiation
  • Suitable for high-acuity settings

Flu + COVID Combo Tests

Combination tests for simultaneous Flu A/B and COVID-19 detection. Ideal during respiratory illness seasons to reduce the number of tests per patient.

  • Single swab, dual detection
  • Flu A/B + SARS-CoV-2
  • CLIA-waived options

Strep Testing

Group A Strep rapid tests.

Rapid Group A Streptococcus antigen detection for urgent care, primary care, and pediatric settings. High daily volume makes this one of the highest-ROI categories for clinics sourcing through GHLS.

Quote Strep Testing Products

Rapid Strep A Tests (Cassette)

Standard rapid strep antigen cassette tests for Group A Streptococcus detection. CLIA-waived. Results in 5–10 minutes. Ideal for high-volume urgent care and primary care settings.

  • Throat swab specimen
  • Results in 5–10 min
  • CLIA-waived
  • High-volume bulk packaging

Strep A Dipstick Strips

Strip-format strep tests — cost-effective alternative for high-throughput clinical environments that run large volumes of strep screens daily.

  • Dip-strip format
  • Group A Strep antigen detection
  • Lower per-test cost

Every test. Full documentation.

All diagnostic products come with complete compliance paperwork — lot numbers, expiration dates, FDA authorization references, and chain of custody.

  • FDA-Authorized / Cleared
